the seeds of the flax plant, eaten as a health food or used to make linseed oil
an oil made from flaxseeds, used in paint or to protect wood, etc.

zh: （织物在制作过程中从表面掉落的）纤维屑，飞花
en: a type of soft cotton cloth used for covering and protecting wounds
a piece of wood, stone, metal or concrete over a door or window that forms part of the frame

zh: (1901-94) a US scientist who won the 1954 Nobel Prize for his discoveries about how chemicals join together. He was known for his opposition to the testing of nuclear weapons and for his campaigns to have all such weapons destroyed. For this, he won the 1962 Nobel Peace Prize. He also believed that people should take large amounts of vitamin C to prevent colds and other illnesses.

zh: Linux 操作系统，Linux 作业系统（基于 Unix 操作系统，基本版本可免费取得）
en: an operating system based on Unix that is available free in the basic version
ex: organizations which use Linux
使用Linux的组织

en: a large, powerful animal of the cat family that hunts in groups and lives in parts of Africa and southern Asia. Lions have yellow-brown fur and the male has a mane (= long, thick hair round its neck).
ex: The lion shook its mane and roared.
狮子摇了摇鬃毛，吼了起来。

en: a female lion

zh: 把（某人）当成名人（或要人）对待
en: to treat somebody as a famous or important person
either of the two soft edges at the opening to the mouth
ex: The assistant pursed her lips.
那女助手噘起了嘴。

zh: a substance that you put on your lips to protect them from sun, wind, etc.
en: a substance that you put on your lips to protect them from sun, wind, etc.
ex: Make sure whatever lip balm you choose has SPF 15.
确保选择的任何润唇膏都具有SPF 15。

en: a substance that is put on the lips to make them look shiny
a substance that is put on the outline of the lips, to prevent lipstick from spreading
